findings.issue: ROUND-1 FINDING, RESOLVED AT THIS HEAD. Raised as MINOR at a81c00cdda: «Cuộc trò chuyện» was byte-identical to ui.chat.sidebar.nav.chats, so the F6 walk announced one name for the nav and the transcript. The head under audit carries the translator's «Khung trò chuyện»; this auditor re-read the value and accepts it. Recorded as INFO because the value being audited is the fixed one and no unresolved finding remains — the round-1 severity above is kept verbatim so the downgrade cannot be mistaken for a clean first pass.

{clock} is supplied by checkpointClockLabel() as 12-hour «h:mm AM/PM», while the vi guide's numbers/dates section specifies 24-hour times. Code-level format outside the catalogue; the vi value consumes {clock} as given. Unchanged at this head, not counted.

With {label} = «Không có tác nhân» the sentence reads «Tác nhân: Không có tác nhân. Gán tác nhân»; the repetition is inherited from the English design («Agent: No agent. Assign an agent») and the sidecar requires {label} verbatim for voice-control matching. Not counted.

«Không có tác nhân» is 17 cells against English 8. The chip is min-w-0 max-w-[24ch] truncate, so it renders whole (17 <= 24) and the conversation title yields instead; no overflow in the styles. No rendered-frame claim. Not counted.

The header and transcript landmarks deliberately share one accessible name (chat-regions.ts maps both onto this key; the English sidecar records the sharing). The vi walk therefore announces «Khung trò chuyện» twice in one F6 cycle, exactly as English announces «Conversation» twice. Design, not translation. Not counted.

khung_is_the_pane_word: ui.chat.aside.close_label = «Đóng khung bên lề» (close side pane)
ui.common.layout.chat_layout.resize_asks… = «Đổi kích thước khung câu hỏi … chiều rộng khung dùng chung» (asks pane / shared pane width)
ui.mesh.mesh_page.canvas = «Khung vẽ», ui.shell.rail.canvas.tooltip = «Đóng/Mở khung vẽ» (canvas pane)
idiom_evidence.khung_is_also_the_time_window_word: 34 of 6061 vi values contain «khung»: 21 in the analytics time-window sense («trong khung này», «khung thời gian», analytics_panel.window = «Khung»), 12 naming a pane or frame (khung vẽ x7, khung bên lề x2, khung câu hỏi / khung dùng chung, «Khung này» for a pane, «Vừa khung»), plus this key. A homonym confined to the analytics namespace, which the chat surface never announces, so no ambiguity reaches the region walk. Noted, not counted.
idiom_evidence.tro_chuyen_is_the_product_noun: 359 of 6061 vi values contain «trò chuyện» (282 with the «cuộc» classifier, 77 without it as a noun modifier, e.g. «Tùy chọn trò chuyện», «Luồng trò chuyện», «Yêu cầu trò chuyện»), so «Khung trò chuyện» follows an established compound pattern rather than inventing one
idiom_evidence.hội_thoại_zero_uses: grep over all 94 vi catalogue files: 0 values contain «hội thoại»; 3 contain «hộp thoại» (dialog)

translator_rejection_of_auditor_suggesti.auditor_position: upheld — the rejection is sound on the evidence, and this auditor withdraws «Hội thoại» as an alternative for this key
reasons: aural collision in the exact context that consumes it: the value is screen-reader-only, and «hội thoại» differs from the catalogue's «hộp thoại» (dialog, 3 uses) by one final consonant — a landmark announced a beat away from a dialog is the worst place to introduce that pair

zero catalogue precedent for «hội thoại» (0/6061) against 359 values built on «trò chuyện»; the style guide's Locale calls record «trò chuyện» as the product's word and ask for terse developer register, while «hội thoại» is the literary/dialogue register
«khung» is the catalogue's own pane word (four independent surfaces above), so the compound names the thing the region is, and it also reads as more informative than a bare synonym of the nav name
translator_rejection_of_auditor_suggesti.residue: two of the four announced names now share the head «trò chuyện» («Khung trò chuyện» / «Cuộc trò chuyện»); they differ in the first word and in what they name (pane vs list), matching English «Chats»/«Conversation». Accepted, not counted.

wording_judgement.style_guide_followup: not a copy defect: the vi style guide's 'Locale calls' has no entry for region/pane naming. Recording «region name → khung + <noun>» there would stop a later translator relitigating vi-wa-1. Left to the translator/manager; this auditor edits no guide.
